paper_title: Counterfactual Influence as a Distributional Quantity
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the accuracy of a model over epochs for both training and validation datasets. The x-axis, labeled "Epoch", has a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 30, with tick labels at intervals of 5. The y-axis, labeled "Accuracy (%)", also has a linear scale, spanning from 40 to 100, with tick labels at intervals of 10. The blue line represents the training accuracy, starting at around 45% at epoch 0, fluctuating between approximately 50% and 70% until epoch 15, then increasing to around 90% by epoch 20, and finally reaching nearly 100% by epoch 25, where it remains steady. The green line represents the validation accuracy, beginning at around 45% at epoch 0, oscillating between roughly 50% and 65% until epoch 15, then gradually rising to about 80% by epoch 30, with some fluctuations in between, notably dipping to around 40% at epoch 10 before recovering.
